payload.fact: SaaS-OMS proven pattern - THREE INDEPENDENT ORDER STATUS AXES (ADR-06): payment_status (unpaid/partially_paid/paid/refunded), fulfilment_status (new/allocated/picked/packed/shipped/delivered), exception_status (none/on_hold/cancelled/returned). Each enum owns allowedNext(); a cross-axis OrderStateMachine owns rules no single enum can know. Solves COD packed-but-unpaid and shipped-then-refunded without hybrid states. Status columns excluded from fillable; only the state machine writes them via forceFill inside DB::transaction
payload.source: Explore agent read SaaS-OMS app/Domain/Orders/OrderStateMachine.php, enums, migrations

payload.fact: SaaS-OMS proven tenancy pattern: single DB, row-scoped, NO package. TenantContext::idOrFail() THROWS when unresolved because returning null compiles to 'tenant_id IS NULL' and silently returns every unassigned row - throwing turns a data leak into a loud failure. BelongsToTenant auto-stamps on create, refuses cross-tenant creates, makes tenant_id immutable. Single greppable escape hatch Model::acrossTenants(). NO Gate::before super-admin bypass. Composite (tenant_id,id) FKs on 10 edges so the DB itself rejects cross-tenant references

payload.fact: COMMISSION ANTI-PATTERN (found in all 3 prior projects): commission rate stored on a MUTABLE settings row with no effective dating. Editing commission_ranks.rate or commission_settings.rate retroactively changes what a re-run of a CLOSED period produces. Fix: effective-dated immutable rule versions (valid_from/valid_to, new row on edit) and stamp rule_version_id onto every commission row
payload.source: Explore agent comparative read of dzi-holistik, AgentStockit, SAAS-Agent-Management commission tables

payload.fact: COMMISSION ANTI-PATTERN: commission calculated INLINE inside a payment-gateway callback (AgentStockit PaymentController:36, SAAS-Agent PaymentController:208) with NO unique index and NO idempotency check. Gateways retry callbacks, so this creates duplicate money. AgentStockit PayoutService::createBatch() also sweeps approved commissions into payout_items but never flips them to paid - running it twice pays the same commission twice. Fix: queued job keyed on order + DB unique index on (order_id,user_id,type,level)
payload.source: Explore agent read of AgentStockit and SAAS-Agent CommissionService and PaymentController

payload.fact: COMMISSION ANTI-PATTERN: no reversal or clawback path exists in ANY of the 3 prior projects. Order refunded/returned/cancelled after payout leaves the commission untouched. dzi-holistik even HARD-DELETES a pending commission to correct it (CommissionService::discardStale). Money rows must never vanish. Fix: reversed state + contra entry referencing the original, event-driven on order cancel/return/refund
payload.source: Explore agent grep for void/reversed/clawback across all 3 projects - zero hits

payload.fact: BEST COMMISSION IDEA found (SAAS-Agent-Management-System): margin-as-commission. Direct commission = (buyer_price - upline_tier_price) * qty computed PER ORDER ITEM. The commission IS the price ladder, so no second rate to configure and no drift between pricing and commission. Also has the finest attribution grain of the three: order_item_id + source_user_id + approved_by on the commission row
